services.name: Whale Watching Cruise with Beach Landing
services.desc: EXPERIENCE SOUTHEAST ALASKA'S AMAZING SEA AND SHORE Private Charter: $1400 for 6 people Additional people $200each, up to 11 people Approx: 4 hours About Meet captain Winston aboard our Motor Vessel the Athena Rose for a truly Alaskan experience on the water. You'll set out to explore the islands around Auke Bay north of Juneau, Alaska, surrounded by pristine mountain views. Keep an eye out for an abundance of wildlife found in these waters - eagles soaring, humpbacks breaching or seals and sea lions playing! Circle the islands, learning about the lighthouses and stunning Great for all ages. An intimate whale watching experience in small groups, 11 people max.

services.desc: Lose yourself in the wilderness! Per Hour: $300 About Plan an amazing adventure off-the-beaten path on a couples retreat or fun group trip with friends. Discover hidden coastlines, beautiful beaches, untouched wilderness and wildlife in their natural habitat. Make it a half day, overnight or extended outing. This is self-guided and you can coordinate drop-off and pick-up times to maximize your time out trekking. We can also shuttle camping gear, equipment or kayaks and provide insight on the best spots to check out! Tell us more about your trip!
